name: actual recorded authentication refusal
message: Failed to authenticate. API Error: 403 Your API key does not have permission to use the specified resource.
why: Explicit authentication words and type, with no model-policy or programme cause

name: account verification is structural

why: A held account needs attention without globally rejecting a credential as invalid

message: Authentication is working; model at capacity

name: sign-in advice after capacity
message: Model at capacity; sign in again if this continues
why: Sign-in advice cannot outweigh a named capacity cause

name: credential refusal with busy advice
message: The credential was rejected; the service is at capacity; try again
why: An explicit credential denial outranks incidental busy advice

name: sign-in advice after network failure
message: DNS resolution failed; please sign in again
why: A named network failure outranks generic sign-in advice

name: logical error in a successful HTTP envelope
message: Usage credits are exhausted; please retry later
why: A success envelope supplies no failure-status evidence to hide a generic wrapper's explicit quota cause

name: native wrapper timeout
why: A generic API wrapper cannot outweigh an explicit transport timeout

name: native wrapper refused connection
message: API Error: Connection refused — a firewall or proxy may be blocking it (ECONNREFUSED)
why: The retained connection failure is more specific than the API wrapper

name: native wrapper interrupted stream
message: API Error: Connection to the API was lost (ECONNRESET). This is usually temporary — try again.
why: Retry advice does not turn a lost stream into provider capacity

name: server wrapper interrupted stream
message: The connection was reset before a response arrived
why: A generic server wrapper defers to an explicit network cause

name: request tokens rate rejection
message: API Error: Request rejected (429) · Number of request tokens has exceeded your per-minute rate limit.
why: Request-token throughput rejects the request without rejecting the credential

name: input tokens request rejection
message: The request was rejected because input tokens exceed the rate limit
why: A token count is usage evidence rather than an invalid sign-in token

name: singular token rate
message: The token rate limit requires a pause before the next request
why: A throughput requirement does not establish credential rejection

name: ambiguous missing model access
message: The model does not exist or you do not have access to it.
why: Alternative explanations do not establish that account access is missing

name: local output limit
why: A local output cap is not a transport failure or provider overload

name: generic api server status
why: An otherwise unrefined server error keeps the HTTP busy default

name: explicit sign in token rejection
message: The sign-in token was rejected as invalid
why: An explicit credential denial remains stronger than a generic rate status

name: native incomplete API envelope
message: API Error: JSON Parse error: Unterminated string
why: A recorded unreadable API envelope is a broken response, independent of the generic terminal wrapper

name: native malformed successful response
message: API Error: API returned an empty or malformed response (HTTP 200); StreamNoEventsError; 0 stream events received
why: A success status printed inside an error message does not make an unusable upstream response a valid model answer

name: model output JSON parsing alone
message: JSON Parse error: Unterminated string in the generated answer
why: Invalid model output does not by itself establish a broken API transport
